## Freigabe-Workflow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Entwicklung] --> B[Review]
    B --> C{Tests grün?}
    C -->|Nein| A
    C -->|Ja| D[Beta-Freigabe]
    D --> E[Store-Einreichung]
    E --> F[Freigabe]
```
